notes.title: Update Notes 1.1.0
notes.notes:
- New mode "Rock, paper, scissors" is now available!
- Romanian language is now supported.

notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.2
notes.notes:
1. Bug Fixes & Balancing Upgrades

- Fixed an issue where subscriptions and gifted subscriptions occasionally didn't trigger the special event.
- Balanced the 'Final Clip' mode for improved gameplay consistency and challenge.

2. Visual Upgrade: “Fall of Fame” Mode

- Introduced new trails and collision effects.

3. New DLC: “Guided Missiles” (Turret Protocol)

- Unleash precision destruction with the new guided missiles, capable of moving in a curved angle.

4. New DLC: “Circle of Nations” (Fall of Fame)

- Alter the appearance of your player with over 100 new flag designs.

notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.1 "Squared Off!" DLC + Bugfixes & Balance Updates
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve got a fresh update rolling out, and it’s time to square up! Here's what's new:

🆕 New DLC: "Squared Off!"

Get ready to strut your stuff in style! The new "Squared Off!" DLC is now available and brings a variety of unique cosmetics to the Fall of Fame mode. From sharp edges to dazzling designs, these new looks will help you stand out on your climb to glory.

⚙️ Bugfixes & Balance Improvements

We've also addressed some minor bugs and made a few balance tweaks on the "Final Clip" mode.

Stay square,
Cyvana

notes.title: Stream Defense Protocol is Live!
notes.notes:
Now Available on Steam: Stream Defense Protocol! 
Get ready to defend your stream like never before!

In Stream Defense Protocol, your audience becomes the enemy. This interactive turret defense game lets viewers join the action through chat or Steam, launching missiles at your base in real time. Upgrade your turret, unleash devastating abilities, and brace yourself for the chaos.
